sentences.text: Leaned APP waives service of notice of rule for and on behalf of the respondent-State.

2. The present bail application is filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure by the applicant for regular bail in connection with an FIR being C.R.No. 11215037230555 of 2023 registered with Vidhyanagar Police Station, District Anand for the offence punishable under Sections 370(a), 376, 372, 120B of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3a, 4, 5(l) and 6 of the POCSO Act and Section 5(1)(d) of the Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act.

3. Learned advocate for the applicant submits that considering the nature of allegations, role attributed to the NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/20488/2023 ORDER DATED: 10/11/2023 undefined applicant, the applicant may be enlarged on regular bail by imposing suitable conditions.

sentences.text: neither named in FIR nor any role attributed to the applicant.
That, the applicant is aged about 30 years and is only the earning person in his family.

That, investigation of the present offence has been completed and the investigating officer has filed charge sheet against the present applicant and therefore, he has requested to enlarge the applicant on regular bail.
4.
Learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the respondent-State has opposed grant of regular bail looking to the nature and gravity of the offence.

That, the victim was aged about 16 years and she was brought from Bangaladesh for immoral traffic purpose and when she was taken by the other co accused from place to place and was made to stay in the hotel, she was subjected to physical torture.
When she was taken to Ahmedabad, the present applicant had a sexual intercourse with her.

That, the applicant is involved in the serious offence as alleged and therefore,
no leniency view would be taken in favour of the applicant while releasing him on bail.
Ultimately, it was submitted by learned APP for the respondent-State to reject present application.

NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/20488/2023 ORDER DATED: 10/11/2023 undefined 5. Having heard learned advocate for the applicant and learned APP for the respondent-State as well as papers produced on record, it appears that the investigation is over against the present applicant and charge-sheet has been filed by the investigating officer against the present applicant.
The role attributed to the present applicant is to the effect that the present applicant had a sexual intercourse with the victim who was below the age of 18 years.
There is nothing on record to indicate that the present applicant was aware about the fact that the victim was aged below the 18 years.
The record further indicates that it was the victim and other co-accused persons, who had tendered her Aadhar Card before the hotel authorities where her age was shown as 18 years.

6. Since trial will take its own time to conclude, the presence of the applicant is not required in judicial custody and therefore, I am of the opinion that this is a fit case to exercise the discretion and enlarge the applicant on regular bail.
Thus, in the facts and circumstances of the case and considering the nature of allegations made against the applicant in the FIR, the prayer of the applicant requires consideration.
